up: Retrieve the distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5726850'. Return the compound preferred name (pref_name) and compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id). Join the docs table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726850') with compound_records on doc_id, and then with molecule_dictionary on molregno.
